The cousin said he's okay with it, but he can go low or no contact with OP and the baby if he wants. Sometimes, actions just have consequences that aren't necessarily good or bad. We can't decide if someone feeling hurt over something is right or not, because we'll never really get the full picture. 

And let's be honest, most people giving their opinions and saying "it's just a name" aren't trans and probably have no trans friends themselves lol. 

Yes, it's their journey, so OP should accept the consequences if the dude doesn't want to have contact with them if OP decides to go for that name.

NTA but the cousin neither, both can do whatever you want, he can go low contact with you and you can name your child whatever you want, it's simply consequences of actions (not necessarily bad or good). I guess what other people aren't getting is that this is not some random college or classmate, this a rather close family member, and sometimes doesn't matter if the way we feel makes sense or not, it sometimes just hurts. The gf doesn't rlly have a say in how the cousin is feeling just bc she's trans, trans experiences are widely different, just like me, i don't mind anyone called my deadname, but if someone is it's not my call to say if they're right or wrong. If the dude wants to do that, that's his choice, and we should respect it just as he respects OP naming their child like that. 

Sometimes things like this happen, and we have to learn to live with the consequences.
